primitives.title: Matrix Reference
primitives.description: Symbolic reference to a feature-by-cell matrix stored in the bundle.

primitives.title: Space Reference
primitives.description: Symbolic reference to a cell embedding or latent space stored in the bundle.

primitives.title: 2D Space Reference
primitives.description: Reference to a two-dimensional cell space, typically UMAP-like coordinates.

primitives.title: Cell Vector
primitives.description: One value per cell, continuous or categorical.

primitives.title: Cell Vector Family
primitives.description: Long-form collection of keyed per-cell vectors.

primitives.title: Relation Family
primitives.description: Sparse long-form cell-to-key relations with optional weights, values, or distances.

primitives.title: Feature Table
primitives.description: Data frame where rows are feature-centric results such as genes, peaks, or markers.

primitives.title: Observation Table
primitives.description: Generic observation-style data frame specialized by table_type and entity_kind.

primitives.title: Model Reference
primitives.description: Reference to a stored model artifact and the spaces it maps between.
use_when: project new data into fitted space

primitives.title: 2D Path Family
primitives.description: Lineage or curve coordinates in a 2D plotting space.

primitives.title: High-Dimensional Space Path Family
primitives.description: Curves in an arbitrary-dimensional bundle space, represented point-by-dimension.
